description: An MIT library that starts throwaway Docker containers, such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server, from test code and removes them afterwards.
A Testcontainers package such as `Testcontainers.PostgreSql` that wraps one image with a builder, a readiness check and `GetConnectionString()`.
A helper container Testcontainers starts to remove leftover Docker resources after the test session, whether the tests passed or failed.
A non-relational provider that evaluates queries over .NET collections, highly discouraged by Microsoft as a test fake and supported only for legacy applications.
Running a writing test inside a database transaction that is never committed, so its changes roll back when the transaction is disposed.
The service `AddDbContext` registers with the provider configuration, which tests remove before registering the context against the test database.
